Purchase Order

Footer templates allow you to add standardized text at the bottom of your purchase orders.

You can create multiple footer templates to use with different types of purchase orders or suppliers.

Managing Footer Templates

Click the New Footer button to create a new footer template.

Each footer template can be customized with specific terms, conditions, and instructions relevant to your procurement needs.

Name
Name

Footers appear at the bottom of your purchase orders and contain important information for your suppliers.

Common Footer Content

Footer templates typically include terms and conditions such as:

• Shipping instructions and delivery requirements

• Quality inspection and acceptance procedures

• Return and rejection policies

• Payment terms and penalty clauses

• Compliance certifications and regulatory requirements

Using Footer Templates

When creating a purchase order, you can select which footer template to use from a dropdown list.

This ensures consistent communication with suppliers while allowing flexibility for different types of purchases.

For example, you might have one footer for domestic orders and another for international shipments with customs information.

Naming Your Templates

Give each footer template a clear, descriptive name that indicates its purpose.

Examples: 'Standard Terms', 'International Shipping', 'Urgent Orders', or 'Service Contracts'.

Good naming helps you quickly select the right footer when creating purchase orders.
